title: Law to let city seal shops for illegal vape sales
summary: This bill would let the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection order the sealing of a store's premises if the retailer repeatedly sells e-cigarettes without a license, sells them to people under 21, or sells flavored e-cigarettes. Sealing would require two unlicensed-sale violations or three underage or flavor violations within a three-year period. The law would take effect 60 days after passage.
